analyst_test: With every file conformed and every rule read, the easy route completes each district's January to June 2026 plan-paid claims with the share of the 2025 plan year that its own January to June carried, which is right for the districts whose plan did not change; but plan-paid claims fall later in the plan year the higher the deductible, and the four districts that moved to the $3,000 deductible have no 2025 at that design, so their own 2025 share overstates what January to June carries and understates their full year.

stakeholder_role: benefits finance manager of a school employees' health cooperative

spine.entity: one member's enrollment in one month

driver: A period's total is completed from its first months by the share those months carry, and the share is set by a design that resets each period and can change between periods: for units whose design changed, their own earlier period's share belongs to the old design, so the share has to come from units already on the new one.
driver_concrete: A district's plan pays little in the first months of a plan year while its members meet their deductibles, and less still at a $3,000 deductible: completing January to June 2026 with the district's own 2025 share works where the plan did not change, but the four districts that moved to the $3,000 deductible had their 2025 on a $500 plan, and the share their January to June carries now is the one the districts already on $3,000 show.
stump: The default path completes each district's January to June 2026 plan-paid claims by its own 2025 and files MV03, MV25 and MV36 raised, because it never asks whether a plan year's claims fall the same way under a different deductible: Brantmoor, Farrowdale and Northam Vale moved from the $500 plan to the $3,000 plan in 2026, whose first half carries less of the year, and they are short of their claims components.

differentiation.task474: task474 carries short counts to a year by a calendar pattern measured at always-on reference sites, the facility-serving sites following their facility's schedule; here no calendar or schedule outside the plan sets the pattern: the plan's own deductible accumulators make paid claims back-load within the plan year, and the share is read by design, from the districts already on the new deductible.
differentiation.task451: task451 completes a period's incurred cost from the arrival history of payments after a handler's delay changed; here the incurred months are complete and the year is unfinished: the part of the plan year not yet incurred is what is projected.

lineage.driver: A record of past events on units is carried to the units as they now stand, and some units were raised after their events, so a past event counts again on a raised unit only where the event's recorded level stood above the unit's new threshold; dropping a raised unit's earlier events, keeping them all, or giving it the later rate of units in its present class each misstates the expected rate.
lineage.stump: The default path drops every claim a building filed before it was elevated and puts the two riverine counties elevated after 2016 in the pilot, because it never asks whether the 2016 water would still have reached the raised floors.
lineage.niche: a regional flood authority's 2027 private flood placement pilot, set on each member county's expected paid building claims per 1,000 insured buildings for the buildings insured today as they now stand, built from the NFIP claims history, the policy terms and the authority's own elevation and acquisition projects, where the 2016 flood rose above the floors the post-flood elevations were built to

lineage.driver: A total for a period not yet counted is carried from the last complete count by the movement of a fixed sample, and the sample covers a shrinking share of the whole because new members join only the whole, at a pace that differs by area and has held steady through every counted period; carrying the last count by the sample's movement, or scaling the sample by the last count's ratio to it, drops one more period of that drift, so the ratio must be carried forward on its own path.
lineage.stump: The default path moves each county's 2024 Department receipts by its member panel's 2025 growth and qualifies Arvenne, Brisholt, Corrigan Bay and Delvane, because it never asks how the panel's growth has tracked the Department's in the years both are known.

lineage.driver: A total kept below a fixed per-unit ceiling is carried to a later period on a growth rate that applies to the uncapped amounts, so each unit's amount grows first and is capped after: a unit already above the ceiling adds nothing to the kept total and a unit just below it adds only what it gains up to the ceiling, so growing the kept total by the rate overstates it most where units sit at or near the ceiling.
